  use Application

  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {SignedApi.NonceStore, []},
      {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: SignedApi.Router, options: [port: 4000]},

defmodule SignedApi.NonceStore do
  use GenServer

  @max_nonces 10_000
  @cleanup_interval :timer.minutes(5)
  @nonce_ttl :timer.minutes(10)

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_) do
    schedule_cleanup()
    {:ok, %{nonces: %{}, draining: false}}
  end

  def check_and_store(nonce, timestamp) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check_and_store, nonce, timestamp})
  end

  def begin_drain do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, :begin_drain)
  end

  def handle_call({:check_and_store, nonce, timestamp}, _from, state) do
    cond do
      state.draining ->
        # During graceful shutdown, we allow requests through without
        # strict nonce checking to avoid dropping in-flight requests
        {:reply, :ok, state}

      Map.has_key?(state.nonces, nonce) ->
        {:reply, {:error, :nonce_reused}, state}

      map_size(state.nonces) >= @max_nonces ->
        {:reply, {:error, :store_full}, state}

      true ->
        new_nonces = Map.put(state.nonces, nonce, timestamp)
        {:reply, :ok, %{state | nonces: new_nonces}}
    end
  end

  def handle_cast(:begin_drain, state) do
    {:noreply, %{state | draining: true}}
  end

  def handle_info(:cleanup, state) do
    now = System.system_time(:millisecond)
    new_nonces = state.nonces
      |> Enum.reject(fn {_nonce, ts} -> now - ts > @nonce_ttl end)
      |> Map.new()
    schedule_cleanup()
    {:noreply, %{state | nonces: new_nonces}}
  end

  defp schedule_cleanup do
    Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup, @cleanup_interval)
  end
end

defmodule SignedApi.ShutdownHandler do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    {:ok, %{}}
  end

  def terminate(_reason, _state) do
    SignedApi.NonceStore.begin_drain()
    # Give in-flight requests time to complete
    Process.sleep(5_000)
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule SignedApi.Auth do
  @secret Application.compile_env(:signed_api, :hmac_secret, "supersecretkey123")
  @max_clock_skew 300

  def verify_request(method, path, body, signature, nonce, timestamp_str) do
    with {:ok, timestamp} <- parse_timestamp(timestamp_str),
         :ok <- check_clock_skew(timestamp),
         :ok <- SignedApi.NonceStore.check_and_store(nonce, timestamp),
         :ok <- verify_hmac(method, path, body, nonce, timestamp_str, signature) do
      :ok
    end
  end

  defp parse_timestamp(ts_str) do
    case Integer.parse(ts_str) do
      {ts, ""} -> {:ok, ts}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_timestamp}
    end
  end

  defp check_clock_skew(timestamp) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if abs(now - timestamp) <= @max_clock_skew do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :timestamp_expired}
    end
  end

  defp verify_hmac(method, path, body, nonce, timestamp_str, signature) do
    payload = "#{method}\n#{path}\n#{body}\n#{nonce}\n#{timestamp_str}"
    expected = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @secret, payload)
               |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    if Plug.Crypto.secure_compare(expected, signature) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end
end

defmodule SignedApi.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  post "/api/transfer" do
    signature = get_req_header(conn, "x-signature") |> List.first("")
    nonce = get_req_header(conn, "x-nonce") |> List.first("")
    timestamp = get_req_header(conn, "x-timestamp") |> List.first("")
    body = conn.assigns[:raw_body] || ""

    case SignedApi.Auth.verify_request("POST", "/api/transfer", body, signature, nonce, timestamp) do
      :ok ->
        # Process the transfer
        send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", message: "Transfer processed"}))
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found")
  end
end
